# Paths whose change may affect data, visibility, evaluation, data flows or defaults.
# Read by .github/scripts/check_data_impact.sh (workflow data-impact.yml): a pull request touching
# one of them carries the label data-impact or ticks "Keine Wirkung" in its description.
# One git glob pathspec per line ('**' spans directories, '*' stays within one); '#' starts a
# comment. Every pattern must match at least one tracked file, and every backend file with an
# outgoing client, a model call, a system prompt or a retention period must match a pattern; both
# are checked by test_check_data_impact.py, which names the file to add.

# Database schema: new or changed stored data
